body.autopilot_title_limit: Autopilot "{{title}}" was not started because this workspace has reached its limit of {{limit}} runs for the current period. The allowance resets {{resetAt}}; a workspace owner or admin can also upgrade or buy more runs.
body.autopilot_limit: This workspace has reached its limit of {{limit}} autopilot runs for the current period. This execution was not started. The allowance resets {{resetAt}}; a workspace owner or admin can also upgrade or buy more runs.
body.app_tool_calls_limit: This workspace has used its {{limit}} app calls for this month. Agents can't run app tools until the allowance resets {{resetAt}}, or until the workspace upgrades or adds seats.
body.project_owner_joined: {{name}} is a workspace owner and added themselves to this private project. They can now see its issues, comments, and attachments.
